mechanism: Lisdexamfetamine increases sympathomimetic activity and cardiovascular stress while empagliflozin increases euglycemic diabetic ketoacidosis risk; amphetamine metabolites may also impair renal perfusion.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely, watch for signs of DKA (nausea, abdominal pain, dyspnea), assess cardiovascular status regularly, and consider alternative ADHD medications if possible.
